image_prompt.text: Green grass verges running along both edges of the dirt track, marking the drivable corridor without blocking it
A start/finish line marker laid across the full width of the muddy track, where the lap begins
The finish side of that same line — a marked band across the dirt track that ends the race when crossed
Bumpy off-road ground: small hills and mounds rolling through sections of the muddy track
Several wooden log obstacles lying across the muddy track
Angled wedge ramp sections built into the track for jumps
Rocks and boulders set as obstacles on and beside the track, in stone gray
Stylized blocky trees with brown trunks and green foliage scattered around the track edges

layout_placement.text: The position racers begin the lap from, on the start/finish line across the track
The round-ending detection zone on the start/finish line, triggered when a racer crosses it on the last lap
Lap and split detection around the loop, so laps are counted and racers cutting across the grass are caught

notes: would have asked: offered Circuit Racing — a closed dirt loop you run laps of, with a start/finish line across the track, lap detection round the loop, and grass verges edging the mud — plus your logs, ramps, bumps, rocks and trees on top. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

Preset caveat: took Circuit Racing's shape (route-circuit) but dropped three of its four options. barrier-guardrail dropped because the prompt edges the track with grass borders, not walls or rails; path-turnaround dropped because the loop already curves continuously; spawn-grid dropped because the prompt names a single start/finish line marker and says no cars are included. Kept trigger-lap and added the startpoint-line / trigger-finish the prompt asked for by name.
start/finish is one physical marker on this circuit: startpoint-line and trigger-finish both name it, so it should be drawn once rather than as two separate structures.
would have asked: confirming the loop is a single closed circuit rather than a point-to-point course, since 'loops around' reads as a lap circuit.
would have asked: whether the log/rock/ramp obstacles should sit on the racing line itself or only at the track edges — read here as on-track, per 'placed on the track'.

tiered comes from terrain-relief (the bumpy sections with small hills/mounds) — elevation with no overhang, so the build stays on the proven route. P6 is the genre-wide Racing route and is not overridden.
would have asked: anything else you want in the space?

The prompt's configurable attributes (TrackColor, GrassColor, Muddiness, TreeCount, ObstacleDensity, TrackWidth) are runtime Roblox attributes rather than layout geometry; TreeCount and ObstacleDensity are tunable parameters, not stated quantities, so no count is recorded. 'Several' logs and 'a few' trees are likewise not counts and stay in the text.
Scale: the prompt says medium-sized, which belongs to the scale band rather than any option here.
